story: Looks like a tombstone: a cross (十) standing over a grave (口). Old.

meaning: I (literary)
story: The five (五) senses are concentrated in the head, where the mouth (口) is. That's "I".

meaning: Risk — as in 冒険 (ぼうけん, adventure)
story: Don't risk looking into the sun (日) with your eye (目).

meaning: Companion
story: Two moons side by side, like two friends walking home together at night. Companions.

meaning: Bright — as in 明るい (あかるい)
story: The sun and the moon together: the two brightest things in the sky.

meaning: Chant — as in 唱える (となえる)
story: A bunch of mouths (口 + the two 日 of 昌) all going at once. Chanting.

meaning: Sparkle
story: Three suns: so much light it sparkles.

meaning: Goods
story: Three mouths that look like boxes stacked up in a shop. Goods.

meaning: Spine
story: Two vertebrae (口) linked by a single stroke. A spine.

meaning: Prosperous
story: Two suns: double the sunshine, double the harvest. Prosperous.

meaning: Early — as in 早い (はやい)
story: Looks like a flower: the sun (日) as its head on a stem (十). Flowers rise early to face the sun.

meaning: Rising sun
story: The sun (日) is well up by nine o'clock (九). The rising sun.

meaning: Generation
story: Three tens (十) joined together make thirty: about 30 years to a generation.

meaning: Stomach
story: The rice field (田) is like the brain, and the stomach is what keeps the brain working. (月 at the bottom or left of a kanji usually means a body part, not moon.)

meaning: Nightbreak
story: The sun (日) coming up over the horizon (一). Nightbreak / dawn.

meaning: Gall bladder
story: 月 on the left means a body part, not moon. A body part + nightbreak (旦): it takes real gall to get up at nightbreak.

meaning: Span — as in 亘る (わたる)
story: The sun (日) between the ground (bottom 一) and the sky (top 一). Its path spans the whole day.

meaning: Concave / dent — as in 凹む (へこむ)
story: Literally looks like a dent. Concave.

meaning: Convex
story: The opposite of 凹: it bulges out. Convex.

meaning: Umbrella — as in 傘 (かさ)
story: A roof (𠆢) with four people (人) huddled underneath, all held up by one handle (十). Umbrella.

meaning: Hundred — as in 百円 (ひゃくえん)
story: One (一) line over white (白): a hundred white sheets of paper.

meaning: Thousand — as in 千円 (せんえん)
story: Ten (十) wearing a little hat (ノ) — ten got promoted to a thousand.

meaning: Ten thousand — as in 一万円 (いちまんえん)
story: One (一) big sweeping sword stroke with a hook — it cuts through ten thousand enemies.

meaning: Half — as in 三時半 (さんじはん)
story: Two horns (丷) on a cow, sliced straight down the middle (丨). Half.

meaning: Small — as in 小さい (ちいさい)
story: A tiny hook (亅) with a little drop on each side. Small.

meaning: Tall / expensive — as in 高い (たかい)
parts: 亠 + 口 + 冂 + 口
story: A lid (亠) on a mouth (口), on a big frame (冂) with another mouth (口) — a tall tower. Tall things are expensive.

meaning: Cheap / safe — as in 安い (やすい)
story: A woman (女) safe under a roof (宀) — and the rent is cheap.

meaning: Rest — as in 休む (やすむ)
story: A person (亻) leaning against a tree (木). Taking a rest.

meaning: Shop — as in 店 (みせ)
story: A building (广) where someone tells fortunes (占) — a little shop.

meaning: Behind / after — as in 後ろ (うしろ)
story: Walking (彳) with a short thread (幺) tied round your dragging feet (夂) — you fall behind.

meaning: Dog — as in 犬 (いぬ)
story: A big (大) animal with one ear flopped up (丶) — a dog.

meaning: Hand — as in 上手 (じょうず)
story: An arm with three fingers spread out across it — a hand.

meaning: Ear — as in 耳 (みみ)
story: The outline of an ear, with lines inside for its folds.

meaning: Foot / leg — as in 足 (あし)
story: A kneecap (口) on top of a leg that stops (止) at the foot.

meaning: Bug — as in 虫 (むし)
story: A bug with a big round body (口), a line down the middle and a little tail flick.

meaning: Cow / beef — as in 牛肉 (ぎゅうにく)
story: A cow from the front: one horn sticking up, a long face and legs.

meaning: Rice — as in 米 (こめ)
story: Grains of rice scattered around a stalk.

meaning: Flower — as in 花火 (はなび)
story: Grass (艹) that changes (化) into something pretty — a flower.

meaning: Sky / heaven — as in 天気 (てんき)
story: One (一) line above a big (大) person — the sky over his head.

meaning: Heart / mind — as in 安心 (あんしん)
story: A heart with drops around it — four strokes, beating.

meaning: Evening — as in 夕ご飯 (ゆうごはん)
story: The moon (月) with a stroke missing — half-risen in the evening.

meaning: Outside — as in 外国人 (がいこくじん)
story: In the evening (夕) the fortune-teller (卜) sets up outside.

meaning: Woods — as in 林 (はやし)
story: Two trees (木 木) — a small wood.

meaning: Forest — as in 森 (もり)
story: Three trees — a whole forest.

meaning: Stone — as in 石 (いし)
story: A rock (口) tumbling down under a cliff (丆).

meaning: Sky — as in 空港 (くうこう)
story: Look up through a hole (穴) in the roof, past the builder’s tool (工) — the sky.

meaning: Body — as in 体 (からだ)
story: A person (亻) built from the root (本) up — the body.

meaning: Blue — as in 青い (あおい)
story: A young plant (龶) growing under the moon (月) — fresh blue-green.

meaning: Red — as in 赤い (あかい)
story: Earth (土) with flames burning underneath — glowing red.

meaning: Every — as in 毎日 (まいにち)
story: Mother (母) puts on her hat (𠂉) every day.

meaning: Voice — as in 大声 (おおごえ)
story: A samurai (士) shouting from under a roof — his voice carries all the way out.

meaning: Meal / cooked rice — as in ご飯 (ごはん)
story: Food (食) you keep coming back (反) to, three times a day: a meal.

meaning: Thing — as in 買い物 (かいもの)
story: A cow (牛) was the most valuable thing a farmer owned.

meaning: Electricity — as in 電話 (でんわ)
story: Rain (雨) clouds with a bolt of lightning striking down: electricity.

meaning: Meet / meeting — as in 会社 (かいしゃ)
story: People (人) gathering under one roof to talk (云): a meeting.

meaning: Exertion / effort — as in 勉強 (べんきょう)
story: Getting out of (免) homework takes no effort; studying takes strength (力).

meaning: Strong — as in 勉強 (べんきょう)
story: A bow (弓) strong enough to shoot down a bug (虫): strong.

reading: たの(しい) / がく / らく
meaning: Fun / music — as in 楽しい (たのしい)
story: A white (白) drum on a wooden (木) stand: music makes things fun.

meaning: Company / shrine — as in 会社 (かいしゃ)
story: An altar (礻) set on the ground (土): a shrine, where everyone gathers.

meaning: Shop / room / roof — as in 部屋 (へや)
story: Under a roof (尸) is where you arrive (至): a room or a shop.

meaning: Self — as in 自転車 (じてんしゃ)
story: A nose: in Japan you point at your nose to say "me".

meaning: Face / surface — as in 面白い (おもしろい)
story: A face framed by its outline, with the nose in the middle.

meaning: Taste / flavour — as in 美味しい (おいしい)
story: Put it in your mouth (口) before it's ready (未): just a taste.

meaning: Request / wish — as in お願いします (おねがいします)
story: Bowing your head (頁) at the source (原): making a wish.

meaning: Measure / count — as in 時計 (とけい)
story: Saying (言) the numbers up to ten (十): measuring and counting.

meaning: Buy — as in 買う (かう)
story: Shells (貝) were money: scoop them up in a net (罒) to buy things.

meaning: Teach — as in 教える (おしえる)
story: A strict hand (攵) guiding a child (子): teaching.

meaning: House / home — as in 家 (うち)
story: A pig (豕) under a roof (宀): in old China the pig lived in the house.

meaning: Cat — as in 猫 (ねこ)
story: An animal (犭) hiding in the seedlings (苗): a cat.

meaning: Road / way — as in 道 (みち)
story: Walking (辶) along with your head (首) up: following the road.

meaning: Clothes — as in 服 (ふく)
story: 月 on the left means body: something that goes on the body. Clothes.

meaning: Window — as in 窓 (まど)
story: A hole (穴) in the wall your heart (心) looks out of: a window.

meaning: Desk — as in 机 (つくえ)
story: A wooden (木) table (几): a desk.

meaning: Seat — as in 席 (せき)
story: Cloth (巾) cushions laid out in a hall (广): seats.

meaning: Language / word — as in 日本語 (にほんご)
story: Words (言) that I (吾) speak: language. (吾 is from RTK lesson 2.)

meaning: Say — as in 言う (いう)
story: Words coming out of a mouth (口) in lines.

meaning: School — as in 学校 (がっこう)
story: Wooden (木) buildings where people mix (交): a school.

meaning: Spirit / energy — as in お元気ですか (おげんきですか)
story: Steam (气) rising: the energy or mood in the air.

meaning: New — as in 新しい (あたらしい)
story: Stand (立) by a tree (木) with an axe (斤): freshly cut wood is new.

meaning: Week — as in 今週 (こんしゅう)
story: Walking (辶) all the way around (周) the calendar: one week.

meaning: Evening — as in 今晩 (こんばん)
story: The sun (日) is excused (免) from work: evening.

reading: あに / にい / きょう
meaning: Older brother — as in お兄さん (おにいさん)
story: A big mouth (口) on legs (儿): your older brother, always telling you what to do.

meaning: Older sister — as in お姉さん (おねえさん)
story: A woman (女) who takes you to the market (市): your older sister.

meaning: Younger brother — as in 弟 (おとうと)
story: Two little horns (丷) on a bow (弓): your little brother playing with toy weapons.

meaning: Previous — as in 昨年 (さくねん). 昨日 (きのう) is a whole-word reading
story: The sun (日) that just (乍) went down: the day before.

meaning: Hall / building — as in 図書館 (としょかん)
story: An official (官) building where you can eat (食): a big hall.

meaning: Practise — as in 練習 (れんしゅう)
story: Thread (糸) wound round and round, east (東) to west: practice is repetition.

meaning: Learn — as in 練習 (れんしゅう)
story: A white (白) bird flapping its wings (羽) again and again: learning to fly.

meaning: Map / drawing — as in 地図 (ちず)
story: Lines and marks drawn inside a frame (囗): a map.

meaning: Ride — as in 乗る (のる)
story: Someone sitting on top of a tree, arms out to both sides (北): riding.

meaning: Live (reside) — as in 住む (すむ)
story: The person (亻) who is master (主) of the house: they live there.

meaning: Hold — as in 持つ (もつ)
story: A hand (扌) holding the temple (寺) offerings: to hold.

meaning: Serve — as in 仕事 (しごと)
story: A person (亻) serving like a samurai (士): to serve.

meaning: Thing / matter — as in 仕事 (しごと)
story: A hand (⺕) holding a brush on a pole: a thing to get done.

meaning: Same — as in 同じ (おなじ)
story: Inside one frame (冂), one (一) mouth (口): everyone says the same thing.

meaning: Origin / former — as in お元気ですか (おげんきですか)
story: Two (二) lines on top of legs (儿): a person standing where they started, at their origin.

meaning: Carry / luck — as in 運動 (うんどう)
story: An army (軍) on the move (辶), carrying its supplies and hoping for luck.

meaning: Sell — as in 売る (うる)
story: A samurai (士) with a cover (冖) over his goods, walking on legs (儿) door to door, selling.

meaning: Noon — as in 午前 (ごぜん)
story: A sundial pole (十) with the sun right on top of it: noon.

meaning: Long / chief — as in 長い (ながい)
story: An old man with long hair flowing down: long, and the eldest is the chief.

meaning: Many — as in 多い (おおい)
story: Two evenings (夕) stacked up: many nights.

reading: すこ(し) / すく(ない) / しょう
meaning: Few / a little — as in 少し (すこし)
story: Something small (小) with a slice (丿) cut off: even less.

meaning: Stand — as in 立つ (たつ)
story: A person with a head (亠) and arms out (丷), standing on the ground (一).

meaning: Push — as in 押す (おす)
story: A hand (扌) pressing on a shell (甲): push.

meaning: Pull — as in 引く (ひく)
story: Drawing back the string (丨) of a bow (弓): pull.

meaning: Floor (storey) — as in 二階 (にかい)
story: Everyone (皆) climbing the hill (阝) step by step: floors.

meaning: Nothing / without — as in 無料 (むりょう)
story: Everything burned in the fire (灬) below: nothing left.

meaning: Fee / ingredients — as in 無料 (むりょう)
story: Rice (米) measured out with a ladle (斗): you pay a fee for it.

meaning: Neck — as in 首 (くび)
story: Two horns (丷) on top of a head (自): the head sits on the neck.

meaning: Hair (body hair, fur) — as in 眉毛 (まゆげ)
story: A single hair with little strands sticking out and a curl at the end.

reading: ただ(しい) / しょう / せい
meaning: Correct / right — as in 正しい (ただしい)
story: Stop (止) exactly at the line (一): that's the correct place.

meaning: Tea — as in お茶 (おちゃ)
story: A person (人) between the grass (艹) and a tree (木), picking tea leaves.

meaning: Young — as in 若い (わかい)
story: Your right hand (右) picking the fresh new grass (艹) shoots: young.
